question.message:
The case is set from the brief and the two demand CSVs. These values did not come from your files — please confirm them (all from the case's assumptions document `knowledge/hackathon-2026-assumptions.md`, which names this exact hackathon case, unless marked otherwise):

1. demand.heating.return_temperature = 60 °C | knowledge/hackathon-2026-assumptions.md, "Case values" (Team, design choice) | colder than the 100 °C supply, as a heating return must be.
2. demand.heating.return_pressure = 6 bar | same document, "Case values" (Team).
3. demand.cooling.return_temperature = 25 °C | same document, "Case values" (Team, design choice) | warmer than the 20 °C supply, as a cooling return must be.
4. demand.cooling.return_pressure = 4 bar | same document, "Case values" (Team).
5. demand.cooling.dew_point_margin = 1 K | same document, "Case values" (Team).
6. demand.cooling.indoor_temperature = 26 °C | same document, "Case values" (Team).
7. demand.cooling.indoor_relative_humidity = 50 % | same document, "Case values" (Team) | gemini reads it as the fraction 0.5.
8. site.air.temperature = 10 °C (constant) | same document, "Case values" (Team) | no weather file or server is connected; a constant, not a series.
9. site.air.pressure = 101325 Pa (constant) | same document, "Case values" (Team).
10. site.fluid.sand_concentration = 20 mg/l | same document, "Case values" (Team).
11. utilities.electricity.co2_intensity = 300 g/kWh | same document, "Rules from the organisers" (organisers, QA-095).
12. utilities.gas.composition = CH4 0.8249507401227822, C2H6 0.039549858193534584, C3H8 0.012748086337494389, CO2 0.011912342910726407, N2 0.110838972435462335 (mole fractions, sum 1) | same document, "Case values" (Team) | this is gas bought from a utility, not the produced gas.
13. time_zone of both demand files = UTC | my assumption, no source | the CSVs' dates carry no offset and neither the brief nor you state a zone; gemini reads dates without an offset as UTC.
14. heat_delivered / cold_delivered unmet_share max = 0.01 | knowledge/hackathon-2026-assumptions.md, "Requirements: tolerances the PDF does not give" (Team, 1 %) | the brief asks that the demand is met but gives no tolerance.
15. full_reinjection reinjection_ratio 0.99999 to 1.00001 | same document, "Requirements" (Team) | the brief requires equal production and injection volumes but gives no band.

The brief's own values (reservoir 2500 m / 100 m / 30 °C/km / 12 °C / 250 bar(g) / 200 mD, brine 1030 kg/m³ / 0.40 mPa·s / 0.8 Nm³/m³ / 80 mol% CH4 / 20 mol% CO2, supplies 100 °C and 20 °C, flow 50–300 m³/h, brine cooling ≤ 40 K, pump efficiency 70 %, 330 days, 1–3 doublets) are in the case as the brief states them.

Which of the 15 values above should change, and to what? Please give each one by its number and path with the new value and unit (for example "3. demand.cooling.return_temperature = 30 °C"). The other values stay as listed.

Economics of the case, from the cost catalogue.
All values are from the case's assumptions document knowledge/hackathon-2026-assumptions.md (EUR at 2015 prices, as the document states). The document sets no per-energy O&M map, so every opex.per_energy key is open; it also sets no subsidy, so the revenue.subsidy keys stay open.
